digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text codec + state-based echo suppression
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must cut over to rich-text codecs (ADF on Cloud, rendered wiki on DC) with echo suppression via state-based baseline diff, not lossy round-trip comparison
DC codec non-idempotence must be bounded by change-gated re-emit counter; a body looping resets at RICH_REEMIT_OBSERVE_AT with one GET via apply_handlers.handle_update, never writing baseline

Local-side baseline comparison must route through normalize_outbound to match decoded baseline wire; emit comparison stays plain inbound-decoded; concurrent both-sides edits remain local-wins with conflict alert
Both DC create paths (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _issues._translate_create_fields) must compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) to render Markdown on CREATE, matching UPDATE behaviour
Cutover flag defaults OFF and is opt-in per client; with marklas extra absent, plain-text ADF path degrades gracefully; rollback restores bit-identical plain-wire behaviour
An 8-byte change-gated rich_sha (not per-pass timestamp) is stored inline in binding; converged bodies add zero entries; the mechanism skips entirely when flag is OFF
